Sentence (English): Looked like it had all the features, but very disappointed.
Comments (English): [ Not a great washer, especially for the price ] || ---------------- || Looked like it had all the features, but very disappointed. Bought it about a year ago at Lowes at this point, but already really hating it and waiting for it to break down so I can buy another. There are a lot of design issues, and the cleaning itself is sub par, even compared to my old $300 washer. Even with prewashing before going in, we have to rerinse like a third of the cups/dishes every wash because there's a film of food on the inside of cups or outside of bowls in particular afterwards. 1. Plastic trim on the control top split and cracked first week. (everyone notes this) 2. 3rd rack doesn't clean well, and when it's in, the top rack doesn't get clean. I had to remove it to even get kinda decent cleaning even if there was nothing in it. 3. The cleaning is awful. We have to pre and post clean now, paying VERY special attention to things like rice/quinoa, pepper or tomato seeds, which will jam the nozzles on the spray arms or the bottle sprayers. Meaning the wash will be even more dirty than usual. Wife hates putting utensils in tines up but spoons and forks don't always clean tines down. 4. Bottle sprayer nozzle has a SQUARE end cap on a round tube. it catches food and stops spraying, I had to drill it out to be round to help that problem, still have to keep tweezers to pick out food from bottle sprayer and hose arms every wash though. 5. The bottom rack fold in tines really don't stay upright with dishes in them, so I had to wire it 'up' with a twist tie. 6. The spaces between wires on the bottom rack are so wide that small round dishes sit in enough to get hit and stop the spray arm, and god forbid you have square dishes that fall corner down during the wash, I had to wire in some plastic coated chicken wire to help stop that problem. 7. The tines are long on the bottom rack, which is fine for plates, but if your family uses a lot of bowls like mine, they're a pain to find a stable position for them since they 'float' because the tines are so long. The rating and reviews suggested it was pretty good. Maybe I got a bum machine, but it's really been rough. At least the Dry Boost seems to do the thing if you don't mind the extra hour it takes!

Comments (English): [ Don't like silverware rack or top rack ] || ---------------- || It's quiet & cleans well. Tells you when it needs rinse aid. Sentence (English): I love this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Fantastic ] || ---------------- || I love this dishwasher. The design of the door is bare except for the brand. The information about the programs is when you open the door. The distribution of the baskets is super practical, they have multiple positions and in particular the cutlery tray is great, it allows you to give depth to half of the tray. I didn't really like dishwashers without baskets, putting each piece of cutlery in its place when it's dirty makes me cringe. But anyway, it allows me to put a basket below and use half of the cutlery tray for tuppers. The double height of that tray is an invention! Regarding the drying issue, you have 2 options, you open the door so it can dry in the open air or you can also deactivate that option. Regarding the washing issue, very good. Many programs to choose from. I love it!
Comments (Original): [ Fantástico ] || ---------------- || Me encanta este lavavajillas. El diseño de la puerta sin nada excepto la marca. La información de los programas está al abrir la puerta. A mí no me gustaba mucho los lavavajillas sin cestillos, eso de poner cada cubierto en su sitio cuando están sucios me da repelús. Pero bueno, me permite poner un cesto abajo y la mitad de ka bandeja de cubiertos utilizarla para los tuppers. Un invento lo de doble altura en esa bandeja! Respecto al tema del secado tienes 2 opciones, te abre la puerta para q se seque al aire libre ó también puedes desactivar esa opción. Respecto al tema del lavado, muy bien. Sentence (English): It takes longer than I thought.
Comments (English): It takes longer than I thought. The basic dishwasher takes 2 and a half hours to wash. It doesn't dry either. If you add hot air drying, it takes even longer. I could hear the sound of it working while I was watching TV in the living room. The fastest one is an hour. People who are impatient would just do it. The price difference is big, but I don't know the difference in performance. A water softener that doesn't leave water marks? The technician said that in our country, even if you just wash the dishes, there are no water marks. He said that there is no need to put salt in from the beginning because it won't be used. Why did you compare performance and price? I think it would have been fine if you just bought the cheaper one. The installation was also really hard. I requested installation on September 6th, but the technician was incompetent. He contacted me the day before and said that he had to go to his island and didn't give me a time. He said that same-day installation was not possible because he had to make a plan. He said that the dishwasher is not simple and complicated when he came to see it. I don't know how much the additional cost will be. It won't be more than 200,000 won. The furniture company will contact you. The furniture company said that it is only possible on September 21st. I told the installer about the schedule, but the order is canceled after 9 days, so I called the place of purchase and I don't even remember the technical terms. Anyway, they told me to submit some kind of inquiry again. They said that they ordered it from LG Electronics. There was no such menu, so I just left it. They said that they could install it right away on the 21st, so I waited, but the installer didn't contact me. Why aren't they coming? I called and they asked when they said they could install the dishwasher on the same day. They said that it would be possible on Monday, the 23rd, after the weekend. They took out the lower cabinets and a new installer contacted me over the weekend. They didn't know anything about the previous situation, so I explained it again. I trust LG for all my home appliances, but this is my first time experiencing something like this. The work is so incompetent. The date designation is meaningless. Anyway, I ordered it and received it 23 days later. You need to improve a lot.

Sentence (English): I had a dishwasher installed at my old house, and doing the dishes for the first time in a while after moving to a new one was actually fun.
Comments (English): [ It's so comfortable. ] || ---------------- || I had a dishwasher installed at my old house, and doing the dishes for the first time in a while after moving to a new one was actually fun. But that feeling was short-lived. The thought of a dishwasher started creeping back in, so since my husband got his bonus, I ordered one right away. It said "Rocket Delivery," so I assumed everything, including installation, would be done in a day. However, due to renovations, rescheduling, and other things, it took well over a week to get it installed. A beautiful and convenient dishwasher has been completed. We are a family of four, but with two kids, we generate a huge amount of dishes every day. Since I can just stack them up, rinse them roughly when I have time, and Tetris them all off, it couldn't be more convenient. Dishwashing that used to take 30 minutes to over an hour is now all done in 5 to 10 minutes :) I feel a bit bad for my 7-year-old and 4-year-old little ones who have recently started enjoying washing dishes, but I'm so happy that I can't help but sing. The one I used before was a Samsung 3-tier dishwasher. I didn't really put anything on the top shelf, but... You know how there are always one or two dishes that can't be put in a dishwasher? It used to be great for quickly drying those, so I'm a bit disappointed that this feature isn't available. The washing sound also seems a bit loud. Pros: It's pretty. Washes thoroughly. The drying function is quite useful (sometimes water pools on top, but I just wipe it lightly with a clean crystal to tidy it up ^^). The price is relatively affordable. Cons: It's only 2-tier, so it falls a bit short compared to the 3-tier model. The sound is on the louder side. This is decent for the price, but I recommend the 3-tier model more!

My only problem with this Bosch dishwasher is that in order to give users flexibility to wash all kinds and shapes of kitchenware, it is much more confusing to figure out how to simply stack cereal bowls for washing. I have watched videos on their website and on YouTube about loading the washer, but haven't found the solution to my dilemma. I have had this unit for 2 months, and the solution may lie in moving the silverware basket over an area of the narrowly spaced tines. I'm still learning. But overall, am very pleased. I'm sure that once I have figured this out, I will love the opportunity for flexibility that Bosch has built into this model. Also, this unit is SO quiet that you can't even hear that it's running.

We wanted to replace our 16 year old Whirlpool, but now scratch our head and ask why. We called before 5PM and he took our information. But because of the delay, he sent us to the appointment department that had since closed. That was on a Friday evening. We pointed this out to the repairman and he didnt know why. But, he witnessed the water problem.One final headache is the space. It seems like they brought in a 6th grader to design the racks. The racks do not allow the dishes to sit up straight causing them to tilt and thus, remove the number of dishes to wash. Similarly with the silverware area. When you drop in a spoon or fork in the slot, it turns and touches other silverware. Maybe we are different, but we like to have the dishes open and airy to ensure a thorough cleaning. I am glad for others who dont have the soap failure, drying problems and rack issues. But after reading the reviews, we found we were not alone with these issues. We recommend the customer bring dishes with them to the store, so you can avoid our headache and evaluate the space issue before you purchase.

Sentence (English): I went from an old KitchenAid to a top of the line Samsung Bespoke and back to the top of the line KitchenAid.
Comments (English): [ Highly recommended, works great & innovative featu ] || ---------------- || I went from an old KitchenAid to a top of the line Samsung Bespoke and back to the top of the line KitchenAid. Old KitchenAid was great, always worked, but just lost some metal pieces in the basket. Samsung was a complete garbage. that's enough said. BUT the new KitchenAid is a class by itself, the dishes are so clean, lot more space to load the dishes, its amazing how much more you can throw into this dishwasher. The choice was bet. Bosch and KitchenAid. I wanted the auto door release, and this is the first KitchenAid that has it. and more. I also like the time left projection on the floor. I thought it might be gimicky, but it is very helpful, since there is no other way to know how much time left. The drying is amazing, even plastic containers come out dry (not 100%, but 80% dry). The basket is very well made, better than the last 2. KitchenAid has been in dishwasher biz for a long time now and it is just as good as a Bosch. I am glad I got this one, and I highly recommend it to everyone. The only downside to it is, there is a long wait time (took me a month to get it), hopefully kitchenaid will correct this.

Sentence (English): LDP6810SS – Purchased Aug. 2021 (less than three years old! )
Comments (English): [ What at piece of junk!  ] || ---------------- || LDP6810SS – Purchased Aug. 2021 (less than three years old! ) I'm 76 years old and I've owned many pieces of equipment over the years and I can say, without a doubt, that this is the absolute worst piece of junk I have ever owned. I've had other dishwashers that have lasted over ten years without problems, and washer/dryers that have lasted almost 30 years, requiring only a drive belt replacement, and that's when I had three kids. I'm one person and the dishes are rinsed before they're loaded.Here's a history of the problems I've had in just the first three years:Aug. 2021 – Initial purchase.Aug. 2021 - Loud thumping noise about two minutes into the wash cycle. Three service reps replaced a bunch of parts guessing at what the problem was. Turned out to be the plastic diverter valve disk was warped. Bending the valve back into shape solved the problem.May 2023 - Pump motor caught fire (yes, smoke & flames). Replaced under warranty.Jul. 2023 - Upper basket starting to rust. One set of the lower basket foldable times won't stay up.Oct. 2023 – Door latch switches failed. These switches are rated at 120VAC but used in a 5 VDC application. Any little bit of film buildup on the contact surface and they don't make contact.Oct. 2023 – Door gasket leaking. In addition to water on the floor, the escaping heat also damaged the front display/control panel.Jan. 2024 - Pump motor over heated (2nd time). LG replaced as safety issue.Jan. 2024 - Middle basket guide rails failed (both sides).Jul. 2024 – Unit powers on for about ten seconds and then display goes blank. No error codes. Three service calls needed to locate the problem. Turned out the turbidity sensor had leaked causing a short, which, in turn, damaged the main control board. Over $500, three service calls, numerous calls to LG “tech support”, and a month invested to get it back up and running. What a piece of junk! LG Technical Support was of little help.On the plus side, it's quite and looks nice. More effort should have been put into reliability and less into the multitude of seldom-used features.

Sentence (English): Don't waste money in this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Do not buy ] || ---------------- || Don't waste money in this dishwasher. First of all, it is hard to self-install. It does not include an elbow required to connect it to the water line. The elbow is available from any home store, but those elbows are meant for garden hose joints and not for plastic to metal joints. So, I had to make two trips to the home store before I could find one which did not leak and had good threads. The second issue is that it has two filters which needs to be cleaned after every wash cycle. The Electrolux I had never needed any filter cleaning. It did not even have a filter. With Bosch dishwasher, cleaning the filters after every cycle is an added chore. Third, it has not even been 6 months and this morning, I noticed that it was displaying a code E9240. The Home Connect app said that the filter system was soiled. I checked the filters and there was no blockage and I cleaned it very thoroughly but the error would not go away. Finally, I had to cut the power at the breaker to get rid of the error. Not sure if it is gone or will come back. Any water that is saved in dishwasher cycle will be wasted in cleaning the micro filter. Also, I am not sure which genius at Bosch decided to face the display upwards so it is not even visible once the dishwasher is mounted under the countertop. In other thoughts, this dishwasher has less space than the Electrolux. It also smells once the dishes are loaded. It needs frequent maintenance and cleaning. No mention of when crystal dry option should be used. I have noticed that if I do not use crystal dry, the dishes come out smelly. The dishwasher manual says that I can load dirty dishes without need to pre-wash. Totally wrong. Unless the dishes are pre-washed, it leaves a residue, not matter what cycle is used. For the price paid, I was expecting a very smooth end user experience, but it is far from smooth.

Sentence (English): We are truly haopy for those that have had good experiences with their dishwasher, but my disabled husband and I have not had that experience.
Comments (English): [ We have been squeezed like a lemon! ] || ---------------- || We are truly haopy for those that have had good experiences with their dishwasher, but my disabled husband and I have not had that experience.If you read the reviews on how to load the dishwasher and/or have this dishwasher, you will notice the learning curve and practice it takes to just learn how to load the dishwasher. My disabled husband has sight, cognitive and dexterity issues. This is too much for him. He can't use the dishwasher because the side racks are very sharp underneath and we have both cut ourselves on the bottom of them when they are flat against the wall. When my husband drops a spoon outside of the utensil rack and fishes at the bottom of the rack, he cuts his hand when pulling the spoon out. This is dangerous for him and his blood cancer. I have done the same. It's very painful. My husband can no longer use the dishwasher because of this safety hazard and because it's too complicated putting different sized glasses in the "glass" area. It's too bad because he had independence with our old dishwasher. This dishwasher takes that independence away. Any family members or guests that come over for a meal and offer to help with the cleaning don't understand how to load the dishwasher. Again, please read reviews. It's like putting together a puzzle. Loading this dishwasher is not automatic and easy.This dishwasher has had the side shelves replaced with the same sharp shelves, the spinners were replaced, the control panels were replaced and the doors have been replaced because of dents. We have multiple case numbers and the dishwasher still doesn't work properly. Dishes and glasses in the back corners don't get clean. I think this is because there is only 1 sprayer pointed in that direction. You have to be absolutely sure that the item is completely clean before putting it into the dishwasher and nothing is blocking the water from the single spinner. This is another reason why my husband can't use this dishwasher.The rinse aid is not being released and there are spots on everything. The tub inside is plastic and also shows all the spots. Another problem is that plastic doesn't dry well in this model and we were told to not put plastic in the dishwasher. My husband uses plastic due to his disability. I use plastic Tupperware for leftovers. None of it is dry even with the heat setting. There is a large amount of soap left on the perimeter of the door. It's a lot of soap not being used to clean the dishes. You will see this complaint in reviews as well. A technician has come to our home to work on the dishwasher multiple times this year. They keep coming and then ordering new parts. I finally had to say enough because I was losing too much time at work. We mostly use paper plates now because the dishwasher just doesn't work correctly. There is a grittiness feeling left on glassware, dishes aren't clean, the detergent tablet doesn't always dissolve (yes, our new hot water has been tested and we run the hot water). While we appreciate GE's 1 year warranty, at some point for the customer's sake you have to refund the appliance or replace it for a new one. It's astounding to us how much money, time, and headache GE has spent on this one single appliance. We'd be happy customers if they would listen to our complaints and resolve this. At this point we don't know what parts can be replaced. Instead, we have been squeezed like a lemon. And that is extra sad for a disabled person. We would not recommend the GE Cafe series. Tried to add optional photos but couldn't on this site.

Sentence (English): Let me just start by saying that I love my Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Love it, BUT .  ] || ---------------- || Let me just start by saying that I love my Bosch dishwasher. It cleans like a dream, and is so quiet there are times you can't even tell that it's on. You got to love that especially when you have an open floor plan so your TV room and your kitchen have one big open space where you can hear everything. Now here comes the BUT. For some reason Bosch after all these years, has still not figured out their water flow system. The ability to drain all of the water out of the line at the end of the cycle, has been an ongoing issue for this brand for years. This is my second Bosch dishwasher and it still has the same old problem of that horrible smell after a few days. You can clean the filter, run vinegar on the inside of your machine, make sure your garbage disposal is cleaned out and deodorized, but it doesn't do any good. It's the way the line for the water drainage is designed for the machine that causes water and old food particles to get stuck. This was explained to me quite thoroughly by a dishwasher repair person who I had come out because I would have sworn something had died and was decomposing in my machine after I came back from vacation. So the overall review is I love the way it cleans, but if you don't run it every single day, you're going to open the door to your dishwasher and there's going to be a smell that makes you gag.

Sentence (English): 20 years ago, I purchased all GE Profile appliances in the color of Bisque for my remodeled kitchen. (
Comments (English): [ Not the Same as a GE Profile ] || ---------------- || 20 years ago, I purchased all GE Profile appliances in the color of Bisque for my remodeled kitchen. (Refrigerator, cooktop, oven and dishwasher) I have been very pleased with all of them. Recently however, my dishwasher's power/electronic board went out and there was no replacement part to be found. Therefore, I had to purchase a new one. A new GE Profile dishwasher was not available in the Bisque color. The only one available in this color is not the quality of the one that I purchased years ago. I would have preferred another GE Profile but it was not an option. The only colors available in the GE profile collection are stainless, black & white. None of these would have looked right in my kitchen. One positive is the Bisque color is a perfect match to all the other appliances. I would ask that this color be made available in the GE Profile collection for future customers as well as myself. My main complaint with the new purchase is with the dry boost/steam+sani cycles. There is no way of escape for the steam to exit the dishwasher once the cycle is complete. Due to this, water remains on the door and in the bottom of the dishwasher. The dishes feel damp somewhat when removed. I never had this issue with the GE Profile Anti=Bacteria cycle. Please consider my request to make the Bisque color available in the GE Profile collection. I'm sure there are others who would agree.

Comments (English): [ I am really satisfied because it can be installed in a small space! ] || ---------------- || I moved to a place with a narrow sink, so I kept looking for a dishwasher that could be installed to fit the size of the sink, but there were none for 6 people. I used a 12-person dishwasher before moving, but it was so hard to use it that I thought, 'Please just have something.' The technician installed it very kindly. Most of the technicians for home appliances at large companies are usually kind, but this technician was so kind that I wanted to give him a perfect score of 100. He took care of things that I didn't (couldn't) mention and was so nice. I had previously used a 12-person dishwasher, so I thought a 6-person dishwasher wouldn't fit much and would be stuffy, but now that I've used it, it's just so convenient and great. Sentence (English): I finally got a dishwasher in my kitchen.
Comments (English): I finally got a dishwasher in my kitchen. I wanted to put it in as a built-in dishwasher under the sink because it has a large capacity, but since the work got bigger,,, I decided on a Samsung countertop. I saw a friend using it at her house and it holds more than I thought and washes cleanly, so I bought it right away. The difference from my friend's model is that the cutlery holder is in the middle and a steam function has been added. At first, it was inconvenient because it was in the middle, but now I'm used to it and it's not that inconvenient. It's good because the dishes are sterilized again with steam and washed more cleanly. It's a shame that I found such a convenient product only now, but it's great for my life that has become more convenient. If you're worried about a dishwasher, don't hesitate and I recommend you buy it right away. The time you used to wash dishes has become your own time, so let's enjoy this happiness^^

Sentence (English): I bought for a new build home.
Comments (English): [ Nice & Basic ] || ---------------- || I bought for a new build home. I love the controls on the top. But found it feels smaller. The rack prongs on bottom are doubled on one side and it's hard to get things in there. The plate side is great. But there are weird spaces that don't have prongs to help. The second row is basic with prongs that will lay down. You can't have very high things here. If your tumblers are more than 20 oz them may be too high. The rack moves, but then the bottom is shortened and I can't get a large plate there. The flatware rack/top rack is standard. The one thing I didn't see is there is no top spray. The middle spray has to go through the middle rack and get to the top. I have had to rewash flatware. Be sure to rinse well. There is also no indicator on the dishwasher when it's done (green light). I eventually hooked up to the app, and it will tell you when it's done. I don't like that, hard to know if it's been on a clean cycle or not. Next time I would get one with a top/middle/bottom spray.

My GE had the pocket handle higher so it was easy to lift the door that way and not have to touch the stainless. Yes, it says fingerprint proof but when you're loading the dishes, you likely have a wet hand or your hand is otherwise not perfectly clean. Overall, I'm very disappointed.

Sentence (English): I received the Whirlpool Eco Series Quiet Dishwasher complimentary through Influenster in exchange for my honest review and love it.
Comments (English): [ Shockingly Quiet ] || ---------------- || I received the Whirlpool Eco Series Quiet Dishwasher complimentary through Influenster in exchange for my honest review and love it. Whirlpool really meant it when they called this one quiet as I hardly notice it running. At times it gets louder where you can hear it for a few minutes, but there is not a constant noise coming from this dishwasher. If I have a TV on or I am in a different room, I cannot hear it. I even thought I did not start it correctly because I did not hear it running for a while. The loudest noise is the ding it lets out to let you know it is done. A great feature of this dishwasher is that it has three racks. A family member has a different three rack dishwasher as well, but their top is very shallow and only allows for utensils. I prefer the design of this rack much more as I use a lot of small ramekins for food prep, and this is the perfect space and allows for me to wash more per load. The middle rack can be raised up for larger items in the bottom and this was very simple to do by holding in the buttons on each side. This washer has several cycles and it was easy to navigate through them with the buttons on top. One of my other dishwashers had very sensitive buttons located over the handle where you would accidentally turn it on when opening and closing and I appreciate this design where the start button is further over from the center. My dishes come out looking clean, and are much dryer than my previous dishwasher; there is little to no standing water on top of bowls or cups. This has an indicator light that is very vibrant and lights blue when washing, red when drying and white when complete. When you open the dishwasher after it is done cleaning, the white light will shut off upon closing. I wasn't sure on the color as I was never a big fan of stainless steel, but the black stainless is absolutely stunning and looks so nice with my white cabinets. This has a mirror like finish that is very elegant and every time I come into the kitchen, I think how much I love the look of this. I hope to be able to switch out all my old appliances to match this beautiful black finish in the near future, and give my kitchen an updated appearance. I really have nothing but good things to say about this dishwasher and I am very happy with the clean dishes it produces.

Sentence (English): I've always wanted a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Washing is satisfactory, drying is a little disappointing ] || ---------------- || I've always wanted a dishwasher. But my apartment has a very low sink shelf, so it's hard to install. But I decided to give it a try anyway. I cut the top a little and put it inside. It washes well. As expected, you have to be good at Tetris to wash well. There are some parts that I couldn't do when the dishes were tilted toward a blind spot? I don't use a separate rinse. The drying function is a little weak. When the door opens automatically after washing, there's hot air. But the drying is a little disappointing. There are still water droplets. I just leave the door open and forget about it for 2-3 hours, and when I clean up the dishes, they're all dry. So I didn't feel uncomfortable about the drying function. I just leave it alone. It's big enough for 12 people~ You can put in a variety of dishes. But when you put in a few large pots, you have to be careful not to get caught in the water spinning. The noise isn't that loud. It wasn't annoying. There are various courses, from 50 minutes to 1 hour and 50 minutes. It was easy to operate. I am satisfied with the cleaning power, but the drying function is a bit disappointing. The interior is spacious and it is easy to operate, so I like it. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (Original): [ 세척은 만족 건조는 조금  아쉬움 ] || ---------------- || 예전부터 식세기가 넘 갖고 싶었어요. 근데 저희아파트가 싱크대 선반이 되게 낮아서 설치가 어렵다고 하더라구요. 그래도 일단 해보자 싶어서 선택햇는데요. 상판을 조금 절단하고 나서 안으로 넣었어요. 세척은 잘 되고 있어요. 역시 테트리스를 잘 해야 세척도 잘 되더라구요. 약간 사각지대? 쪽으로 그릇이 기울어지거나 하면 미처 되지 못한 부분들이 있기는 해요. 린스는 따로 사용하지 않고 있구요. 건조기능은 조금 약해요. 세척 완료 후 자동으로 문이 열릴때 보면 뜨끈한 열기는 있어요. 근데 건조는 조금 아쉬워요. 물방울이 그대로 있거든요. 그냥 문 열어둔 상태로 2~3시간정도 잊고 있다가 그릇 정리할때 되면 그때에는 잘 말라있네요.  그래서 굳이 건조기능에 대해서는 불편하진 않았어요. 그냥 내버려두면 되니까요.ㅋㅋㅋ 12인용이라 크기는 해요~  그릇종류도 다양하게 들어가구요. 근데 큰 냄비 몇개 넣을때에는 물이 나오는 회전에 걸리지 않게 유의해야해요. 소음은 그렇게 크지 않아요. 거슬리지 않았구요. 50분부터 1시간 50분 코스까지 다양하네요. 작동방법도 쉬웠어요. 세척력은 만족, 건조기능은 조금 아쉽지만~ 내부도 넓고 작동이 쉬워서 좋아요. 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Better late than never ] || ---------------- || All of our friends and family know me as the anti- dishwasher member of the clan. I hated how the dishes felt after washing and just would rather do them by hand. Until last year . I am a private chef and get to experience a lot of dishwashers in homes I visit. The noise, the not-really-clean dishes, you name it I experienced it until I met my first Bosch dishwasher. My clients dishwasher was 22 year old and it did a magnificient job and I was really curious and asked her about it. She said that she had always stuck with Bosch because they last forever and clean like what she found to be perfect not just okay. Hmmm, this sounds interesting. Fast forward a year, I am back for another party with her and low and behold a new Bosch for me to visit! And it was magnificient! Absolutely perfect and I was finally sold that we needed to add a dishwasher to our home. After doing extensive research, we settled on the Benchmark Series Top Control 24-in Smart Built-In Dishwasher With Third Rack (Stainless Steel) ENERGY STAR, 39-dBA. I waited this long, let's go all in! And boy, I am so glad I did. First, it drives me and the cats crazy by barely making any sound at all. The cats sit and stare at the very cool light on the floor telling me what it is doing at the time and for about a week, I kept questioning whether or not it was working at all! LOL Cleaning? Unbelieveable! I have tried every conceiveable type of burnt sauce pans, dirty cheesey bowls, you name it and I swear this dishwasher laughs at me and says, "Come on, you can do better than this! " Every single piece of silverware and glassware is perfect, every single time. We are blessed to have the very best water in the state where I live and it is so good and this dishwasher is so good, we do not have to use any rinse products and the glasses just sparkle. In retrospect, I wish I had gotten on board earlier but waiting til you produced this machine was worth the wait. I am one very happy, very satisfied customer and I can not thank you enough for this outstanding product. When in homes, I always manage to talk to my clients about making their next dishwasher a Bosch, the ones pros use ! Thank you again, I am a Bosch gal from here on!

Also, it removes even the stubborn grime from pots and pans, so it cleans much better than washing them by hand. Everyone, if you're struggling with a lot of housework—even if you don't own your home and can't get a built-in unit—just buy a freestanding one. Comments (English): [ Better late than never ] || ---------------- || All of our friends and family know me as the anti- dishwasher member of the clan. I hated how the dishes felt after washing and just would rather do them by hand. Until last year . I am a private chef and get to experience a lot of dishwashers in homes I visit. The noise, the not-really-clean dishes, you name it I experienced it until I met my first Bosch dishwasher. My clients dishwasher was 22 year old and it did a magnificient job and I was really curious and asked her about it. She said that she had always stuck with Bosch because they last forever and clean like what she found to be perfect not just okay. Hmmm, this sounds interesting. Fast forward a year, I am back for another party with her and low and behold a new Bosch for me to visit! And it was magnificient! Absolutely perfect and I was finally sold that we needed to add a dishwasher to our home. After doing extensive research, we settled on the Benchmark Series Top Control 24-in Smart Built-In Dishwasher With Third Rack (Stainless Steel) ENERGY STAR, 39-dBA. I waited this long, let's go all in! And boy, I am so glad I did. First, it drives me and the cats crazy by barely making any sound at all. The cats sit and stare at the very cool light on the floor telling me what it is doing at the time and for about a week, I kept questioning whether or not it was working at all! LOL . Cleaning? Unbelieveable! I have tried every conceiveable type of burnt sauce pans, dirty cheesey bowls, you name it and I swear this dishwasher laughs at me and says, "Come on, you can do better than this! " Every single piece of silverware and glassware is perfect, every single time. We are blessed to have the very best water in the state where I live and it is so good and this dishwasher is so good, we do not have to use any rinse products and the glasses just sparkle. In retrospect, I wish I had gotten on board earlier but waiting til you produced this machine was worth the wait. I am one very happy, very satisfied customer and I can not thank you enough for this outstanding product. When in homes, I always manage to talk to my clients about making their next dishwasher a Bosch, the ones pros use ! Thank you again, I am a Bosch gal from here on!

The noise, the not-really-clean dishes, you name it I experienced it until I met my first Bosch dishwasher. She said that she had always stuck with Bosch because they last forever and clean like what she found to be perfect not just okay. Hmmm, this sounds interesting. Fast forward a year, I am back for another party with her and low and behold a new Bosch for me to visit! And it was magnificient! Absolutely perfect and I was finally sold that we needed to add a dishwasher to our home. Unbelieveable! I have tried every conceiveable type of burnt sauce pans, dirty cheesey bowls, you name it and I swear this dishwasher laughs at me and says, "Come on, you can do better than this! We are blessed to have the very best water in the state where I live and it is so good and this dishwasher is so good, we do not have to use any rinse products and the glasses just sparkle. In retrospect, I wish I had gotten on board earlier but waiting til you produced this machine was worth the wait. I am one very happy, very satisfied customer and I can not thank you enough for this outstanding product. When in homes, I always manage to talk to my clients about making their next dishwasher a Bosch, the ones pros use ! Thank you again, I am a Bosch gal from here on!

Comments (English): [ Water, water everywhere. Flawed design. ] || ---------------- || Whoever designed this must have never loaded or operated a dishwasher! Could no longer deal with the watertap, E24, E15, add salt errors on the extremely expensive ten year old Bosch. Installed July 16, 2024 and began leaking water from the facing the left side on August 8. Dishwasher is level. I'm glad I had the foresight to have a dishwasher tray installed. GE/Bodewell technician stated to not put any dish directly in the front middle on the top rack (not utensil tray) as that may be blocking the sprayer arm. Began leaking again within three weeks. I now keep a rolled towel in front. Technician came out again and stated to keep the first four tine section depth in the front free, as I had taken a picture of the load. Still leaking. Tech stated water is hitting the door and cannot be fixed as the dishwasher is dry underneath. It's a design flaw so I must obtain a return authorization from GE. Since all tines are vertical, bowls do not get clean unless they are angled. Cycles: cannot use most of them mainly due to leaking. Bottle jet cycle tends to jet food off, but increases leaking. Hot water boost bakes the food in further, normal dry boost partially melted and warped a thick storage container on the second rack. I bake eggs in ramekins and the egg has never been completely removed. The sani/steam cycle appears to be the best for baked on food. I utilize a 6 quart crockpot, and the only place I've found to set it is on the bottom rack towards the front, angled back so the top of the crockpot is resting on the second to the last tall tines in the rear of the dishwasher. People complain about cycle length. This is now normal because the government mandated appliances must use less energy. Dishwashers used to use about seven gallons of water, and now use three to four; so longer contact time is the only way to clean them. Speaking of clean; the dishwasher smells like all the food I've cooked when I open it to let the dishes dry after the cycle. And there is no manual. It must be downloaded and printed for a detailed review of the dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ I had such high hopes. ] || ---------------- || The wife and I were looking for a new dishwasher as our previous dishwasher was pushing close to 20 years and the internals were rusting. It's great that I don't have to worry about plastics being melted, but it's terrible that I have to prewash dishes and then dry them afterwards from a dishwasher that costs approximately $1000. Look elsewhere for a better dishwasher because this one is terrible.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher after over 10 years of using a more basic dishwasher and are very pleased so far.
Comments (English): [ Super quiet, lots of flexibility ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher after over 10 years of using a more basic dishwasher and are very pleased so far. Here's what I like most about it: - Super quiet. Other than when it is draining, it's hard to tell the machine is even running. I didn't know a dishwasher could be this quiet. - Lots of flexibility in how items can be loaded. Many of the the tines can be lowered as needed to accommodate items of different shapes-- super useful for washing after cooking. - The uppermost (utensil) rack for utensils is awesome. As others may have noted, tall utensils won't fit in this uppermost rack, but most normal cutlery will fit just fine. Chopsticks fit nicely without risk of falling through. If your items don't fit the uppermost rack, you can always use the removable basket in the bottom rack. I like to remove the bottom rack to have more space for big items likes pots, pans, etc. - The middle rack height can be adjusted (just pay attention to whether the rotating sprayer clears the items in the bottom rack. - Good range of wash program options, including emphasis on different levels. This is great if a particular rack needs more washing than others. - Cheerful music when the cycle has ended. If you've used other Korean or Japanese appliances, you are familiar with this. Somehow it makes the end of the cycle celebratory, and any added cheerfulness when it comes to chores is a plus for me. Minor improvements I would suggest, if LG is reading: - Please make the tines in the lower rack a little taller and thicker! - An additional row of collapsible tines would make the lower rack even better - Splitting the removable basket into two smaller baskets would provide even more flexibility. If I use the utensil rack, there's a significantly lower need for the basket, but I have to commit to the entire basket if I use it at all, and it is huge.

Sentence (English): Finally, I got a dishwasher auntie~ .
Comments (English): Finally, I got a dishwasher auntie~ . These days, dishwashers are essential, so I was looking into buying and subscribing, and I chose a subscription because I was more concerned about hygiene and the residue that comes from washing dishes. I think I can manage it well by myself now, but I think I won't be able to clean it on time as I live. I signed up for a subscription that comes once every 6 months to clean and change the filter, which is reassuring. The most important dishwasher performance! I thought it would be cleaner if I did it by hand, but I was so relieved and satisfied when I saw that it was washed cleanly and disinfected and sterilized. I also bought a capsule detergent, but I can wash a lot of dishes cleanly with one, so I think I use very little detergent. It has various functions such as drying only and sterilizing only, and it was good that I could use various optional functions by connecting it to the LG THinQ app. Among them, I use the top rapid mode well. When there are only a few dishes, I put them on the top of the tray and use it rapidly. There are also many convenient and good functions such as oily dishes and delicate mode, so I use them well. I recommend using the dishwasher with a subscription.
Comments (Original): 드디어 식세기 이모님 들였네요~ 요즘 식세기는 필수라 하여 구매와 구독을 알아보던 중에 아무래도 그릇을 씻으며 찌꺼기도 생기고 위생에 신경이 더 쓰여 구독을 선택했어요.지금은 셀프로 관리를 잘 할 것 같아도 살다 보면 제 때 청소가 안될 것 같더라구요. 6개월에 한번씩 와서 청소도 해 주시고 필터도 갈아주시는 걸로 구독 신청하여 든든합니다. 가장 중요한 식세기 성능!! 사람 손으로 하는게 아무래도 더 깨끗할 거라 생각했는데 뽀득뽀득 깨끗하게 씻기고 소독, 살균 되는걸 보고 너무 안심하게 만족하게 되었습니다. 세제도 캡슐로 구매 했는데 하나 넣으면 많은 그릇을 깨끗하게 씻을 수 있으니 세제는 정말 적게 사용하는것 같아요. 건조만, 살균만 하게하는 등 여러 기능이 있고 LG THinQ 어플과 연결해서 다양한 옵션 기능을 사용할 수 있어 좋았어요. 그중, 상단 급속 모드 잘 사용하고 있어요. 그릇이 조금밖에 없을 때 트레이 상단에만 놓고 급속으로 사용합니다. 그 외 기름기 많은 식기, 섬세 모드 등 편리하고 있으면 좋은 기능들이 많아 잘 활용하고 있어요.구독으로 식세기 사용해 보시는것 추천합니다.

These days, dishwashers are essential, so I was looking into buying and subscribing, and I chose a subscription because I was more concerned about hygiene and the residue that comes from washing dishes. I think I can manage it well by myself now, but I think I won't be able to clean it on time as I live. I signed up for a subscription that comes once every 6 months to clean and change the filter, which is reassuring. The most important dishwasher performance! I thought it would be cleaner if I did it by hand, but I was so relieved and satisfied when I saw that it was washed cleanly and disinfected and sterilized. I also bought a capsule detergent, but I can wash a lot of dishes cleanly with one, so I think I use very little detergent. It has various functions such as drying only and sterilizing only, and it was good that I could use various optional functions by connecting it to the LG THinQ app. Among them, I use the top rapid mode well. When there are only a few dishes, I put them on the top of the tray and use it rapidly. There are also many convenient and good functions such as oily dishes and delicate mode, so I use them well. I recommend using the dishwasher with a subscription.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher gets everything clean.
Comments (English): [ Very Happy! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher gets everything clean. I followed the directions and didn't rinse my dishes. I just pushed off the leftover food on my dishes into my compost bin and put them in the dishwasher. I should also say I only run my dishwasher when it is full. It might take me three or four days to get it full. I use earth friendly dishwashing soap, not a big well-known detergent. Yet, everything comes clean. If I have pots and pans in the load, I use the "heavy" cycle, otherwise I just use the "normal" cycle. On the upper rack, I put the serving utensils that are too big for the silverware holder, and they have been coming clean too. Just incredible! I have no complaints, and I highly recommend this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): My previous dishwasher was over 25 years old and I found myself needing a new one.
Comments (English): [ My new dishwasher ] || ---------------- || My previous dishwasher was over 25 years old and I found myself needing a new one. While shopping, I had planned to stick with the brand that I was replacing, but the saleman gave a very good pitch for the Bosch brand. I brought it and once it was installed my confusion started right aways. These new electroinic types of appliances is a challenge for senior citizens. I had to call customer service to find out to operate it, even after reading the manule over and over. I am very perplex about the settings, due to the fact that my dishes were still wet when the cycle has finish. Now, after having it for over a month and using it for about 10 uses, I find that I'm not exactly a happey camper with this brand. It looks very nice, but the function is not meeting my satifaction. I've noticed after every use the inside drum still have water driplets on every surface and after loading it and leaving the dishes to be wash for a day or so (until I get enough to have a full load) it has an unpleasant smell. The plastic types of dishware is still wet and I have to dry off upon removing them. A step I used when hand washing. I'm using it and drying all the plastic ware which I never had to do with my previous 25 year old dishwasher. I found myseld putting off giving this review until I thought I would have somehing more positive to say, but that day hasn't arrived as of yet.

Wish the unit came with some salt to start with because it is not easy to find and purchase the salt. I found it on Amazon. I am very please with the performance of the dishwasher so far. Sentence (English): Purchased this dishwasher in September 2024 after my previous Whirlpool dishwasher (purchased in 2015) stopped doing its job, and the wheels literally fell off multiple times after daily use.
Comments (English): [ Reliable dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Purchased this dishwasher in September 2024 after my previous Whirlpool dishwasher (purchased in 2015) stopped doing its job, and the wheels literally fell off multiple times after daily use. Overall, I was happy with the previous model and it often was run twice per day to keep up with baby bottles, toddler sippy cups, and all the plates and bowls young people seem to go through each day. So far, the new model seems very similar to the 2015 version, just added a 3rd rack. I have been using the 3rd rack daily to put sippy cup covers, extra silverware, mixing spoons, etc. It is nice to have a little more space for those small items. Overall, the dishwasher cleans the dishes very well, no residue, and haven't had to pre-rinse or wash again after the cycle. Even with generic dishwasher soap. It is not a quiet dishwasher (neither was the old one), but that wasn't a priority for me. The heavy cycle (which I almost always use) runs close to 4 hours. There is a "quick" cycle that runs about 90 minutes for wash and dry and can get the job done if you need it to on a smaller load. I am happy with this purchase for the price point and the features. After looking at other brands in person, this seems sturdier than others in this price range. If I can get another 9 years out of this one, I will be happy.

It is not a quiet dishwasher (neither was the old one), but that wasn't a priority for me.  The heavy cycle (which I almost always use) runs close to 4 hours.  There is a 'quick' cycle that runs about 90 minutes for wash and dry and can get the job done if you need it to on a smaller load. I am happy with this purchase for the price point and the features. After looking at other brands in person, this seems sturdier than others in this price range. If I can get another 9 years out of this one, I will be happy.

Sentence (English): Our 25 year old Miele gave up the ghost.
Comments (English): [ Beko dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Our 25 year old Miele gave up the ghost. Because we didn't want to spend a fortune, we chose Beko after some deliberation. You would think that 25 years later, appliances have improved on everything that needs improvement. Too bad, that old Miele is running circles around our new dishwasher. More fit in, easier to arrange, the dishes were cleaner, faster and drier. I wonder how designers manage to design such clumsy appliances. The racks fold down everywhere, but you can't get a decent wine glass in properly. Very large plates? Too bad, almost nothing fits on top of the dishwasher. Lighting is funny though. To end on a positive note. Of course, it is almost impossible to register how it is with energy consumption. Or you have to put a consumption meter in between. So we have to believe that modern appliances are more economical.
Comments (Original): [ Beko vaatwasser ] || ---------------- || Onze 25 jaar oude Miele gaf de geest. Omdat we geen kapitaal uit willen geven na wat wikken en wegen de Beko gekozen.Je zou denken dat 25 jaar verder apparatuur verbeterd is op alles dat verbetering nodig heeft.Jammer, die oude Miele draait rondjes om onze nieuwe vaatwasser.Er ging meer in, handiger in te richten, de vaat was schoner, sneller klaar en droger.Ik vraag me af hoe ontwerpers het voor elkaar krijgen om zulke onhandige apparatuur te ontwerpen. Omklappen de rekjes overal maar een fatsoenlijk wijnglas krijg je er niet goed in. Hele grote borden? Jammer dan, past er bovenin de vaatwasser bijna niets meer.Verlichting is wel weer grappig. Om positief af te sluiten.Hoe het zit met het energieverbruik is natuurlijk amper te registreren. Of je moet er een verbruiksmeter tussen zetten. Dus we moeten maar geloven dat de moderne apparatuur zuiniger is.

This is a product that I am 200% satisfied with. I think I made a really good purchase^-^

Sentence (English): I remember the old Maytag commercials when I was a boy during the 1960s.
Comments (English): [ The Maytag repairman still is lonely ] || ---------------- || I remember the old Maytag commercials when I was a boy during the 1960s. The ads showed the maytag repairman sitting around waiting for a phone call that never came: That was simply because the machines never broke down. I have a 37 year old Maytag washer and dryer in my kitchen these days. Only during the pandemic did they finally need some repairs while having never needed any repairs over the 37 years. A friend of mine who is a psychologist and in her 70s. She is from my generation. Comments (English): [ This dishwasher has it all! Silence, savings and ease of use ] || ---------------- || Since I got this dishwasher, my life in the kitchen has changed for the better. This little thing is super quiet thanks to its EcoSilence motor, so much so that I don't even notice when it's running. Even at night, with the Silent mode, it's barely audible, and I can take advantage of the hours of lower energy costs without disturbing anyone. Ideal for saving a few euros on the electricity bill! ⚡. One of the things I like most is how easy it is to use and how well it cleans everything. I usually use the ECO program, which leaves the plates, glasses and pots spotless in an hour, but when there's more stubborn dirt, I change to a more intensive program and that's it! Also, the option of automatically opening the door at the end of the cycle is a plus, because it helps everything come out really dry and I don't have to go around with the cloth drying anything. The Home Connect app is another plus that I can't help but mention. From my mobile I can control the dishwasher, program cycles and even download additional programs. Not to mention the energy assistant that helps me choose the cheapest times to run it! In addition, the interior design is very practical, with the adjustable upper tray that allows me to accommodate everything from delicate glasses to large pots. Without a doubt, this dishwasher has everything I was looking for: efficiency, convenience and top technology. Highly recommended!

Sentence (English): While having owned the product for only a week, we are duly impressed with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ High quality appliance ] || ---------------- || While having owned the product for only a week, we are duly impressed with this dishwasher. The construction, fit and finish, and overall quality is very good. The user's manual took a bit to get used to as it is written and arranged somewhat awkwardly (and maybe that's just our perception). It has done an excellent job cleaning the dishes et al. What a great improvement over our previous, 25 year old appliance! And quieter too. The controls are straight forward and you do *not* have to "hook-up" with the wifi/app if you don't want to (Editorial comment: It's a dishwasher, we can press buttons and close the door. You're already standing directly in front of it after loading it up, right? ). But if you want to program specific cycle set-ups, set start times, etc., go nuts; lots of features! Love the red dot light projected on the floor to indicate an active wash cycle and the tinkly chime when the load is done. If you are tall (and we are), you will have to bend down pretty significantly to open door fully to load the lower rack and close door again; door is hinged closer to the floor than our old dishwasher so we are getting used to that. The Bosch-Home website has many helpful videos. At this stage, we can recommend this model if it's in your price point budget.

Comments (English): [ So Quiet and Actually Cleans the Dishes ] || ---------------- || This is a great dishwasher. It has a very modern, sleek, clean design. Paired with the Bosch app, it lets me know when my cycle is done, when my finishing rinse is getting low, and allows me to customize my cycles. And I love the top rack for cutlery! It saves so much space on the bottom rack for adding bulky containers and pans. My only complaint is that I can't seem to collapse the optional prongs on the bottom left rack, despite watching the how to videos. Otherwise, this is well worth the extra money.

Sentence (English): After being a little disappointed with the claim that it will dry “everything”, including plastics, we weren't able to get what we were hoping for.
Comments (English): [ Shaky start, but works well w/settings adjustments ] || ---------------- || After being a little disappointed with the claim that it will dry “everything”, including plastics, we weren't able to get what we were hoping for. There is an option on the dishwasher for "crystal dry", and we had that selected, but it still wasn't doing what we hoped for. We called Bosch and they told us that you have to open the dishwasher door almost immediately after it finishes the cycle. The 500 series has this as a feature (the door opens automatically), so why doesn't the 800 series have it? We had an appliance person come out and they said the same thing. They also suggested that we change to using the detergent pods instead of the liquid detergent. We used to use Cascade Complete (liquid) and we switched to Finish Quantum Powerball (pods). Eventually after looking all through the app I found another setting called "Intensive Dry". No one at the Bosch support desk nor the appliance person mentioned anything about this other feature. After we selected the "Intensive Dry" feature in the app and the “Crystal Dry” feature and with the new dishwasher pods, we got much better results. There is always a little water that will puddle in little crevasses, but that is to be expected. I am dropping one star from this review because I think it relies too much on using the app instead of just being able to press the buttons on the actual dishwasher from some basic features. The feature for "Intensive Dry" is only available in the app. Setting a delayed start is only available in the app. “Custom Power Control” for the lower rack spray zones is only available in the app (this one is a little more advanced, so I can see why it's just in the app). I am sure there are others that I haven't even found yet. I am pretty technologically savvy and I really like technology, but it is a little annoying that I have to pull out my cellphone to run my dishwasher. In closing, I do like the dishwasher and I do like its features, but I wish some basic features (especially delayed start) were available as a button on the machine itself.

Comments (English): [ Operationally worked well - issue with door ] || ---------------- || I had this product for a little over a year, slightly past the warranty date. I believe there is a reason why it is not warranted beyond one year. The dishwasher worked fine but the door broke down. At first they were going to do nothing, then I told them the issue was a safety concern and they then responded. They made an appointment for someone to come out and take a look at it. Apparently a spring came loose. They paid for the technician to do the diagnosis but didn't want him to fix it. They told me they would replace the dishwasher and would let me know when someone would come out and replace it and take mine. I was later told they could not find anyone to install the new dishwasher and remove mine - they could only have someone drop off the new dishwasher and pick up mine which had to be done on the same day. They stated they would pay $150.00 for the install and removal. Any technician I hired would have to come out and charge twice for 2 trips. The cost to pay a technician to do this was approximately the price of the dishwasher. Understand I already paid a year earlier for the dishwasher and for install/removal. I told whirlpool to forget it. Now you know what you can expect.

At first they were going to do nothing, then I told them the issue was a safety concern and they then responded. They made an appointment for someone to come out and take a look at it. Apparently a spring came loose. They paid for the technician to do the diagnosis but didn't want him to fix it. They told me they would replace the dishwasher and would let me know when someone would come out and replace it and take mine. I was later told they could not find anyone to install the new dishwasher and remove mine - they could only have someone drop off the new dishwasher and pick up mine which had to be done on the same day. They stated they would pay $150.00 for the install and removal. Any technician I hired would have to come out and charge twice for 2 trips. The cost to pay a technician to do this was approximately the price of the dishwasher. Understand I already paid a year earlier for the dishwasher and for install/removal. I told whirlpool to forget it. Now you know what you can expect.

Sentence (English): I am a father/husband of a family of 5 that was looking to replace a 20 year old plus GE Profile dishwasher that met its demise.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, cleans and dries extremely well! ] || ---------------- || I am a father/husband of a family of 5 that was looking to replace a 20 year old plus GE Profile dishwasher that met its demise. I found this dishwasher that seemed to fit the bill. At my previous house I had a Bosch 100 series which I had been satisfied with but had left my dishes and plastics somewhat wet. I liked the Kitchen Aid reputation and that this one had a heating element. I also liked having a 3rd rack, lots of space design and the reasonable price point. At this point we have run 5 loads of dishes. I removed the silverware container and use strictly the third rack. I run normal wash, high temp, sani rinse with the extended heat cycles. The dishes have come out spotless and dry. The machine is extremely quiet (whisper). The loads have been run at night and seem to take longer to run than the old style machine I replaced. I would guess it runs probably somewhere between 2-3 hours on the cycles I have used. I still have not used the quick wash cycle so I can't comment on its speed or how that cycle would clean. At this point I am very pleased with the purchase and I am hoping to get at least 10 years of use. I have been told by many that they don't make them like they use to so I am not expecting the same 20 years the other one had but the performance has been outstanding so far. If anything changes I will update this review but if your looking for quality that doesn't break the bank this seems to be a great choice from Kitchen Aid.

Sentence (English): The Bosch dishwashers are an excellent choice.
Comments (English): [ QUALITY ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY ] || ---------------- || The Bosch dishwashers are an excellent choice. I'm old. I have had a few dishwashers. The Bosh series do not seem to wear internally. I replaced my 10 year old unit with this one because the pump went out on the old one and I wanted an upgrade in technology. I was surprised to see that the bullet proof guts that were in my old unit are used in my new one. It would seem Bosch subscribes to one of my long held beliefs that "if it's not broken, don't fix it". The app that can be used to operate the dishwasher, (if you choose to), took me a bit to get familiar with but within half an hour it was a breeze. The ability to customize schedules and wash cycles is really nice. All you need to install is a water supply hose and a place under the counter. This thing is quiet too. I have to put my ear up to the door to see if it's really running. The efficiency is incredible as well. We rinse our dishes well and use the fastest most eco friendly cycle and the dishes come out spotless. If I'm still kicking in ten years I'll buy again.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || I'm a family of four, and I'm a second grader. I was really worried about buying a dishwasher. After much deliberation and searching, why did I choose this product? Since it's not my own home, I chose a dishwasher for 6 or more people, excluding built-in models. 1. Depth: Because of the sink size, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is just right because it's under 40cm. Most dishwashers for 6 or more people are at least 50cm deep. It was a perfect fit, as if it were custom-made. In fact, dishwashers that are 50cm deep are quite large, but this product was just the right size. 2. Price and after-sales service: It's cheaper than major brands, and there are two new products that are available with or without a window, and they cost about 50,000 won. This one has a UV sterilization function, so I chose this one. The fact that Coupang offers a 2-year free service was a big plus. The same goes for the free installation of Rocket in just one day. 3. One-week review I was worried because there were no reviews for pre-order, but I trusted the previous media dishwasher review and bought it. I'm really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after eating has been greatly reduced. It's so convenient that I regret not buying it sooner^^ The dishes are cleaner and there are less water stains than I thought. Tips for use- - There is no separate detergent dispenser, but there is a separate space to put it under the door. - The noise level is lower than I thought. - When the basic time is selected, it takes a total of 65 minutes and the door opens automatically when it's finished. - There is no drying function? And the part about it not drying wasn't a big inconvenience to me. As soon as you open it, it's quite hot, and after about 30 minutes of opening the door, it's almost dry. There's a little water collected at the bottom of the overturned cup, but it's not a big problem - Tip: If you pre-wash the dishwasher well, you can use the dishwasher cleanly for a long time. You rinse most of it with water, but if there's sticky rice-like particles on the spoon, you can wipe them with a sponge and put them in to make it cleaner - Water stains I haven't cleaned the dishwasher separately until now, but there are almost no water stains - Small? Compared to other dishwashers for 6 people or more, the depth is 50, so the inside is spacious, but this product has two floors, so there is no big problem using it for a family of 4-5. We give each person a little bit of side dishes and use a lot of dishes. Usually, 5-7 dishes are used per person, and they all fit ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots we use when cooking separately. This effort is not even washing dishes compared to before ^^ This is my review after using it for a week. I will use it more and add a review ^^ Hope it helps~-10. 23 days - One month after using it, I really love Auntie Dishwasher. I've been using it almost every day and I'm very satisfied. There was a slight fishy smell in the cup in the middle of the cycle, so I was really worried whether it was the detergent or the dishwasher. I asked the customer service center, and after searching online, they said to put vinegar in it and run it once, so I poured some vinegar in an empty dishwasher and ran it, and the smell disappeared from the next time. And the day before yesterday, it happened a little bit, but it was fine again the next day. Come to think of it, if there's a lot of dishes to wash, I think I can add a little more detergent or reduce the amount of dishes. Or I can use vinegar again. It's enough for a family of four. Of course, I do the large trays and pots myself. This alone makes me feel completely free from washing dishes. Oh, and by the way, I recommend not using knives or handles with plastic, cups with pictures on them, or wooden materials. They can become deformed or discolored due to the high temperature. I think there may be harmful substances released.

I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after eating has been greatly reduced. It's so convenient that I regret not buying it sooner^^ The dishes are cleaner and there are less water stains than I thought. Tips for use- - There is no separate detergent dispenser, but there is a separate space to put it under the door. - The noise level is lower than I thought. - When the basic time is selected, it takes a total of 65 minutes and the door opens automatically when it's finished. - There is no drying function? And the part about it not drying wasn't a big inconvenience to me. As soon as you open it, it's quite hot, and after about 30 minutes of opening the door, it's almost dry. There's a little water collected at the bottom of the overturned cup, but it's not a big problem - Tip: If you pre-wash the dishwasher well, you can use the dishwasher cleanly for a long time. Come to think of it, if there's a lot of dishes to wash, I think I can add a little more detergent or reduce the amount of dishes. Or I can use vinegar again. It's enough for a family of four. Of course, I do the large trays and pots myself. This alone makes me feel completely free from washing dishes. Oh, and by the way, I recommend not using knives or handles with plastic, cups with pictures on them, or wooden materials. They can become deformed or discolored due to the high temperature. I think there may be harmful substances released.

It's so convenient that I regret not buying it sooner^^ The dishes are cleaner and there are less water stains than I thought. I think there may be harmful substances released.

I think there may be harmful substances released.

Sentence (English): We are a family of four with a second grader.
Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.
