Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Sentence (English): It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made.
Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Sentence (English): Review After One Week of Use.
Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Sentence (English): I am really satisfied after using it for a week.
Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Sentence (English): I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner.
Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Sentence (English): Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use.
Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.

Comments (English): [ After using it for a week, I am completely satisfied. ] || ---------------- || We are a family of four with a second grader. I spent a lot of time deliberating on which dishwasher to buy. Why did I choose this product after so much thought and research? Since I don't own my home, I excluded built-in models and selected one for 6 people or more. 1. Depth Size. Due to the size of my sink, the depth is only 40cm, but this product is under 40cm, so it was a perfect fit. Most dishwashers for 6 people or more have a depth of 50cm or more. It fit perfectly, as if it were custom-made. Actually, dishwashers with a depth of 50cm are really big, but this product's size was just right. 2. Price and After-sales Service. It is cheaper compared to major brands. There are two newly released models that differ in whether or not they have a window, with a price difference of about 50,000 won; this product has a UV sterilization function, so I chose it. The fact that Coupang offers free service for over 2 years was also a big advantage. The free Rocket Installation within one day was also great. 3. Review After One Week of Use. I was worried because there were no reviews since it was a pre-order sale, but I trusted the reviews from previous Midea dishwashers and made the purchase. I am really satisfied after using it for a week. I run it twice a day, and the burden of washing dishes after meals has been drastically reduced. I never knew it could be this convenient; I regret not buying this sooner. Dishes come out clean, and there is less water staining than I expected. Usage Tips: - Detergent Inlet: There is no separate compartment; there is a separate space to place it at the bottom of the door. - Noise: It is not as loud as I expected. - Time: On the default setting, it takes a total of 65 minutes, and the door opens automatically when finished. - No Drying Function? I didn't find the lack of a drying function to be a major inconvenience. As soon as you open it, there is quite a bit of heat, and it is almost dry about 30 minutes after the door opens. There is a little water pooling at the bottom of inverted cups, but it isn't a big issue. - Tip: If you pre-wash well, I think you can keep the dishwasher clean for a long time. I mostly rinse with water, but for sticky rice grains on spoons, scrubbing them with a scouring pad makes them even cleaner. - Water Stains: I haven't wiped the dishwasher separately so far, but there is almost no water staining. - Is It Small? Looking at other brands' dishwashers for 6 or more people, they are 50cm deep and spacious inside, but this product is a two-tier design, so it is not difficult for a family of 4-5 people to use. We serve small portions of side dishes to everyone and use a lot of dishes; usually, each person uses 5 to 7 items, and they all fit in. ^^ Of course, we wash the large pots used for cooking separately. Compared to before, this little bit of effort is nothing. ^^ That is my review after one week of use. I will add to the review after using it more. ^^ I hope this helps. -October 23rd-. One-Month Review. Long live the Dishwasher Lady! I have been running it almost every day so far and I am very satisfied. One time, a cup smelled a little fishy. I was really worried, wondering if it was the detergent or the dishwasher, so I asked customer service. I looked it up online and found that I should try running it with vinegar. So, I poured a little vinegar into the empty dishwasher and ran it, and since then, there has been no smell. Also, something like that happened a little the day before yesterday, but it was fine the next day. Come to think of it, if there are a lot of dishes, I think I can just add a little more detergent or reduce the amount. Or I can use vinegar. For a family of four, the amount of dishes is sufficient. Oh, of course, I wash the large trays and pots myself. Just doing that makes me feel completely free from the chore of washing dishes. Oh, and as a side note, it is best not to put knives, items with plastic handles, cups with designs on them, or wooden items in the dishwasher. Because of the high temperature, they tend to deform or change color. I think harmful substances might be released.
